senses.gloss:
Ghāsa means ‘fodder’ in the Atharvaveda^1 and later.^2 In
the Rigveda^3 Ghāsi is used of the fodder of the horse victim
at the Aśvamedha.
1) Av. iv. 38, 7; viii. 7, 8; xi. 5, 18,
etc.
2) Vājasaneyi Saṃhitā, xi. 75; xxi. 43;
Taittirīya Saṃhitā, vi. 5, 9, 3; Tait-
tirīya Brāhmaṇa, i. 6, 3, 10, etc.
3) i. 162, 14.
